node.statement: For X=U,V, epsilon_X<=W.L*epsilon<=t_3. Also d_X<=c0*epsilon_X<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3. The two unit bounds forward separately and exactly: ||v_U(I_{B_U})-u_{A_U}||<=c0*epsilon_U<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3, and ||v_V(I_{B_V})-u_{A_V}||<=c0*epsilon_V<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3. The original sharper inequalities d_X<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_X are hypotheses and are unchanged.
